description: Calculate حق‌الثبت, the STATE registration duty on a notarised document: 0.5% of the amount in a financial document (art. 123 of the Registration Act, as amended 1384), and the 1405 fixed amounts of art. 124 items (budget law 1405, table 16). Distinct from حق‌التحریر (the notary's own fee — use calculate_notary_fee). Marriage/divorce and company registration are refused (no official 1405 tariff / a separate capital ladder).

amount_toman.description: Amount in the document, or its statutory base, in Toman (financial and vehicle_sale_poa only).

doc_kind.description: financial = sale/gift/mortgage/lease…; vehicle_sale_poa = vehicle sale power of attorney; non_valued = a document whose subject cannot be valued; signature_cert; rescission (فسخ/اقاله); copy_page (per page); registry_certificate; duplicate_deed (المثنی); true_copy_page (برابر اصل, per page).

name: calculate_stamp_duty
title: محاسبهٔ حق‌الثبت — Calculate registration duty
